column1: **filter_6thdiff_vert:** Vertical 6th-order filter on w selector: 0=off; 1=on *C-O if filterSelector == 1*
**filter_6thdiff_hori:** Horizontal 6th-order filter on rho; theta; qv selector: 0=off; 1=on *C-O if filterSelector == 1*
**filter_6thdiff_vert_coeff:** Vertical 6th-order filter factor: 0.0=off; 1.0=full *C-M if filterSelector == 1 and filter_6thdiff_vert == 1*
**filter_6thdiff_hori_coeff:** Horizontal 6th-order filter factor: 0.0=off; 1.0=full *C-M if filterSelector == 1 and filter_6thdiff_hori == 1*
